traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria from docs/stories/024.0-DEV-IGNORE-INLINE-CODE-REFS.story.md are satisfied:,- Core functionality & common patterns: normalizeCommentLine uses `/`[^`]*`/g` to strip any backtick-wrapped spans and tests confirm that backtick-wrapped `@story`, `@req`, and composite patterns like `` `@story` + `@req` `` leave no @story/@req/@supports tokens in the normalized text.,- Real annotations detected: when a line mixes inline-code references (e.g., `@supports`) and a real @story annotation, tests show the normalized result begins at the real @story tag, so only the actual annotation is processed.,- Multi-line support: processComment splits comments into lines and runs normalizeCommentLine on each; thus backtick filtering applies uniformly across all lines of a multi-line comment.,- No regression: a full Jest run (`npm test -- --ci --no-watch --runInBand --verbose`) shows all suites passing, including the new Story 024.0 tests, confirming the normalization change did not break existing behavior.,- Documentation: the JSDoc for normalizeCommentLine explicitly describes the inline-code/backtick filtering and boundary preservation, documenting the behavior required by the story.,Unit tests in tests/rules/valid-annotation-format-internal.test.ts are explicitly traced to docs/stories/024.0-DEV-IGNORE-INLINE-CODE-REFS.story.md and to REQ-IGNORE-INLINE-CODE, REQ-PRESERVE-BOUNDARIES, and REQ-CENTRALIZED-FILTER, providing direct traceability between the specification and the implementation.
